name: n8n_incident_fanin_reopen_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: n8n_incident_fanin_reopen_20261107 — LQ-20261107-116. The fan-in's key is per (source, item, UTC day) and
the gateway's CONSUMED is terminal, so a finding that closed and came back the same day used to be republished
under its closed key: the receipt said open, the ledger said closed, and it could never be closed again.
The fix walks to the next occurrence key (<key>-r1, -r2, ...) after a recovery closure, never after an operator
ack, and caps the walk. Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI.
